faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Assistant Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the RITES Assistant Manager (IT/Network & security) post is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Assistant Manager (IT/Network & security) position at RITES Limited.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Manager post is 32 years, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Manager (IT/Network & security) role will be offered a pay scale of INR 40,000 to 1,40,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for the RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 600/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 300/- for EWS/SC/ST/PWD candidates, plus applicable taxes.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for RITES Assistant Manager?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of three stages: a Written Test, followed by Document Scrutiny, and finally a personal Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply offline for this job?
faq.answer: No, the application process for the RITES Assistant Manager (IT/Network & security) recruitment is strictly online through the official RITES website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s or Post Graduate Degree in Computer Engineering, IT, Electronics, or related fields as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is any work experience required?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are required to have at least 2 years of experience in one or more of the areas mentioned in the job description.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the job be located?
faq.answer: The job location for the Assistant Manager (IT/Network & security) position is mentioned as Across India, with the headquarters in Gurgaon.
